llms.body:
# https://cline.bot/ llms.txt
> Cline is a collaborative AI coding platform with agentic workflows, plugin-based extensibility, and deep integration into development environments. It helps developers code faster, automate workflows, and integrate AI safely into local and cloud-based engineering stacks.
##Product Overview
- [Collaborative AI Coder](https://cline.bot/): Team-focused AI coding assistant to enhance productivity.
- [Cline IDE Install Page](https://cline.bot/get-cline?ref=cline.ghost.io): Set up Cline in VS Code and other IDEs.
- [MCP Marketplace](https://cline.bot/mcp-marketplace): Discover and install MCP plugins to enhance AI development.
- [Cline for Enterprises](https://cline.bot/enterprise): Enterprise-scale AI coding with customizable agent frameworks.
##AI Workflows & Capabilities
- [Plan & Act Paradigm](https://cline.bot/blog/plan-smarter-code-faster-clines-plan-act-is-the-paradigm-for-agentic-coding): Cline's agentic planning model for smarter development.
- [Cline Coding Agent](https://cline.bot/blog/what-makes-a-coding-agent): Deep dive into Cline as a next-gen coding agent.
- [Cline's AI Context Framework](https://cline.bot/blog/inside-clines-framework-for-optimizing-context-maintaining-narrative-integrity-and-enabling-smarter-ai): Manage LLM context windows for better outcomes.
- [Memory Bank](https://cline.bot/blog/memory-bank-how-to-make-cline-an-ai-agent-that-never-forgets): Persistent memory tools for AI agents.
##Tools & Integrations
- [MCP Servers Explained](https://cline.bot/blog/mcp-servers-explained-what-they-are-how-they-work-and-why-cline-is-revolutionizing-ai-tools): Learn how MCP plugins power modular AI workflows.
- [Essential MCP Servers](https://cline.bot/blog/supercharge-your-cline-workflow-7-essential-mcp-servers): Curated list of must-have servers.
- [Build MCP Plugins](https://cline.bot/blog/calling-all-developers-how-to-build-mcp-plugins-with-cline): Developer guide for MCP plugin creation.
- [Cline and Supabase](https://cline.bot/blog/manage-your-database-directly-from-cline-with-the-supabase-mcp): Connect Cline to your databases.
##Documentation & Guides
- [What is Cline?](https://docs.cline.bot/getting-started/what-is-cline): Introduction to the Cline platform.
- [Cline Setup Guide](https://cline.bot/blog/cline-beginner-intermediate-advanced-finding-your-ideal-setup): Beginner to advanced installation steps.
- [Installing Cline](https://docs.cline.bot/getting-started/installing-cline): Step-by-step installation guide.
- [AI Model Selection](https://cline.bot/blog/what-model-should-i-use-in-cline): Choose the right AI model for each task.
- [Optimize Cline’s Context](https://cline.bot/blog/clines-context-window-explained-maximize-performance-minimize-cost): Improve performance and reduce token usage.
- [.clinerules Guide](https://cline.bot/blog/clinerules-version-controlled-shareable-and-ai-editable-instructions): Create reusable rules for your AI agent.
- [Task Management Guide](https://docs.cline.bot/getting-started/task-management): Learn how to manage tasks in Cline.
- [Prompt Engineering Guide](https://docs.cline.bot/prompting/prompt-engineering-guide): Best practices for prompting AI models.
##Trust, Privacy, and Ethics
- [Cline's Commitment to Freedom](https://cline.bot/blog/why-we-built-cline-to-never-hold-you-hostage): Philosophy behind open-access AI tooling.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cline.bot/privacy): Understand how Cline handles your data.
- [Terms of Service](https://cline.bot/tos): User agreement and responsibilities.
- [Anonymous Telemetry](https://cline.bot/blog/introducing-anonymous-telemetry-in-cline): Data collection for product improvement.
- [Security at Cline](https://docs.cline.bot/enterprise-solutions/security-concerns): Overview of enterprise security features.
##News, Updates & Vision
- [Cline Blog](https://cline.bot/blog): Company updates, insights, and tutorials.
- [Latest Version: v3.18](https://cline.bot/blog/cline-v3-18-gemini-cli-provider-optimized-claude-4): Most recent updates and improvements.
- [1M Installs Milestone](https://cline.bot/blog/1-000-000-installs-and-our-all-in-bet-on-the-future-of-software-engineering): Growth and impact.
- [Why Cline Doesn’t Index Codebases](https://cline.bot/blog/why-cline-doesnt-index-your-codebase-and-why-thats-a-good-thing): Emphasis on privacy and security.
##Use Cases & Thought Leadership
- [Use Cases](https://cline.bot/tag/use-cases): See how developers use Cline.
- [Human Intent in AI](https://cline.bot/blog/why-human-intent-matters-more-as-ai-capabilities-grow): Why purpose still matters in AI.
- [AI Talent Needs](https://cline.bot/blog/talent-ai-companies-actually-need-right-now-and-how-to-identify-it-2): Hiring trends in the AI space.
- [Economic Impact of Cline](https://cline.bot/blog/what-happens-when-you-5x-the-output-of-every-engineer-unlocking-trillions-in-economic-value): Developer productivity at scale.
##Other
- [FAQ](https://cline.bot/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Careers](https://cline.bot/careers): Join the Cline team.
_Last-Updated: 2025-07-16_

© 2026 Cline Bot Inc. All rights reserved.

The open agent

One open source agent runtime.
Use it in your editor, your terminal, or embed it in your own products.

Trusted by 11M+ developers.

DesktopNew

Cline for Desktop: the coding agent as a native desktop app. No editor required.

Download for MacDownload for Windows

IDE

Install the Cline extension in your editor of choice.

  • Install Cline in Visual Studio Code
  • Install Cline in Windsurf
  • Install Cline in JetBrains
  • Install Cline in Cursor

CLI

From prompt to production, right inside your terminal.

$npm i -g cline

SDK

Embed the agent runtime that powers Cline in your own apps.

$npm install @cline/sdk

Trusted by developers and leaders at

See Cline at work

One agent across your IDE, terminal, and SDK.
Pick a task and watch it run.

Understand

See how a codebase is structured and ask Cline questions about files, dependencies, and behavior.

Everything an agent should do,
in your editor and your terminal.

Open source. Plan-and-Act. Every model. No vendor lock-in.

Edits across your project

Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.

Plan, then act

Toggle Plan mode to align on a strategy, then Act to execute. Approve every step, or flip auto-approve for autopilot.

Every model, your choice

Claude, GPT, Gemini, local Ollama / LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Bring your own key or your own weights.

Runs bash commands

Executes in your terminal and reacts to output as it appears. Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.

Rules and Skills

Ship .clinerules with your repo to teach the agent your coding standards, architecture, and deployment conventions.

Extend with MCP and plugins

Register custom tools and lifecycle hooks via the SDK. Plug in MCP servers for databases, APIs, and infrastructure.

Connect to Slack, Linear, and CI

Chat with the agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear. Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.

Multi-agent teams and schedules

Coordinator agents delegate to specialists with their own tools and context. Run them on cron for recurring automations.

Read the full docs

Any model, your infrastructure

Cline works with every major provider.
Bring your own key, your own endpoint, or your own weights and keep your workflow exactly the same.

Ready to experience AI coding
without limits?

Start using Cline
